logp.method_description: The lipid-water partition coefficients of the complexes 6a, 6b were determined by shake flash method. The standard curve was firstly obtained by preparing three complexes with different concentration gradients using water saturated octanol solution. Subsequently, 1 mg of the complexes added to a mixture of 1 mL water and 1 mL octanol. Then the mixture was shaken in a thermostatic shaker (150 rpm/min and 300 K) for 24 h. Centrifugation at 1000 rpm for 5 min was allowed to stand pending separation of the upper and lower layers. UV-Vis spectra was used to determine the concentration of the complex in the organic phase (Co), the concentration of the complex in the H2O phase Cw = Ctotal–Co, finally the logP = log(Co/Cw) value was obtained.
